candidate.status: source candidate built from the fix tree (the commit differs only by rustfmt whitespace); not a published-package measurement

reasoning: Ligands of C3: N4 > {C2, C5} > H. C2 and C5 begin constitutionally identical ring branches (C2(OMe)-C10(OH)-C8(OH)-C5(OMe) and C5(OMe)-C8(OH)-C10(OH)-C2(OMe)), so Rules 1-3 tie and Rule 4b decides.

Auxiliary descriptors in the digraph rooted at C3 (each centre's back-to-root ligand ranked by hierarchical Rule 1a): branch C2: C2 R, C10 R, C8 S, C5' S; branch C5: C5 R, C8 S, C10 R, C2' S (C5' and C2' rank their ring-closure duplicate of C3 below the path atom, so they invert).

Like/unlike sequences against each branch's first descriptor, in hierarchical order: C2 branch l,l,u,u; C5 branch l,u,l,u. The first difference (second centre) is like versus unlike; like precedes unlike, so C2 > C5.
N4 > C2 > C5 > H with the input's [C@@H] (neighbour order C2, H, N4, C5) is S.
adjudication.root_cause: the back-to-root ligand of an embedded centre was ranked by pooling each sphere into one multiset; at C10 of branch C2 that compared {N,C,C,H} with {O,C,H,H} (back ligand loses) instead of the oxygens' branches {C} with {H} first (back ligand wins), flipping C10's auxiliary descriptor to S and the sequence to l,u,u,u
